blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Daily News (CDN) Digital secured back-to-back institutional wins at the second Cebu Metropolitan Catholic Mass Media Awards (CM-CMMA), with its entries recognized in two major Print/Online categories in English. The outlet won in News Writing and Special Reporting, the same categories where it received institutional awards during the inaugural CM-CMMA in 2024. Winning entries Leading this year’s wins was CDN Digital Chief of Reporters Pia Piquero, whose entries earned recognition in both categories.
